final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderflow), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.status, step1.avg_filled, step1.record_count, 1.0 * step1.record_count / step2.total_count FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.total_count IS NOT NULL
